title: Address classification table implementation
notes: Implemented a public isolated AddressClassificationTable exported via lichen.rpl without touching dirty routing/dodag/loadng. Stable precedence: fe80::/10 direct_neighbor; canonical 0200::/8 with live authenticated evidence local_mesh; 0200::/8 without evidence identity_preserving_global; other/unknown off_mesh. Authenticated updates canonicalize equivalent IPv6 text and compose the 1200s EvidenceTable, inheriting exact expiry, bounded capacity, no live eviction, source validation, and monotonic u64 regression/overflow safety. Added dedicated closed schema plus 7 canonical operation scenarios covering precedence/expiry, canonical spellings, auth rejection, non-primary rejection, capacity fallback/reuse, time regression, overflow, and invalid addresses. Green: 28 focused pytest, ruff, mypy, JSON/schema and diff checks. Read-only Rust inspection found no corresponding classifier; dirty Rust loadng/lib untouched, cargo no_std check green. No codereview/commit/push.
